description: Return one publisher's games, alphabetically by title, with each one's lowest listed price per platform. Use it for a publisher's catalogue, such as everything from Rockstar Games; for a series, which can span publishers, use get_franchise_games, and for one game's store offers get_game_offers. `slug` is the publisher's id as search_games lists it under publishers (rockstar-games), and an unknown slug returns an error result. Only priced games are returned; `total` is the full count, which can exceed `limit`. Links go through getcheapgames.com and carry the stores' partner tracking; listed prices exclude the service fee marketplaces add at checkout.

country.description: Two-letter market code, any case, e.g. de, gb, us, br or pl (40 markets). It decides the currency prices come back in, which keys count as region-locked, and the market every link opens in. Omitted or unsupported codes fall back to ie (Ireland, euro).

slug.description: The publisher's slug, e.g. "rockstar-games": a `publishers` slug from a search result.

name: get_publisher_games

bestListedPrice.description: The cheapest in-stock price of a key that activates in the market.

bestMayNotActivateHere.description: True when every key is region-locked for the market, so bestListedPrice is a locked key's.

buyUrl.description: Redirect through getcheapgames.com to the cheapest in-stock key.

pricesByPlatform.description: Lowest price per platform, e.g. {"PC": "19.99 EUR"}.

slug.description: The game's id, for its offers.

thirtyDayLow.description: A decimal amount such as 19.99, in the game's `currency`.

title: List a publisher's games
